runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.evidence: CHIPOTLE_ENTREE_IDS expects bowl, burrito, quesadilla, salad, tacos, high-protein-menu, kids-meal, chips-sides, and drinks. Generated builderConfig exposes burrito, bowl, salad, quesadilla, taco, tacos-3, kids-build-your-own, and kids-quesadilla.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.impact: Generated taco and kids keys are rejected by URL/state parsing, while high-protein-menu, kids-meal, chips-sides, drinks, and tacos are not present as generated config keys.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.resolution: Add a runtime/enrichment adapter that preserves the old user-facing navigation model while pointing each choice at generated IDs and source relationships. Do not rewrite generated source identities.

runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.evidence: Generated builderConfig has entreeOptions and categoryMaxSelections only; the old config also has selectedIngredientCategoryOrder, selectedIngredientCategoryLabels, and chipotle-specific kids/taco/special-variant metadata.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.impact: Kids selector options are empty, taco shell and special kids behavior lose their configured IDs, and ingredient tabs lose curated labels/order.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.resolution: Preserve presentation fields and re-key every relationship-bearing value to generated IDs. Generated relationships remain authoritative.

runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.gap: No entreeGroup values in generated items
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.evidence: The old file assigns entreeGroup to all 60 items; the generated file assigns none. Current menu-mode filtering and high-protein editability use entreeGroup.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.impact: chips-sides, drinks, and high-protein-menu views filter to empty lists; generated preset meals are not recognized by isChipotleEditablePresetBuildItem.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.resolution: Layer a runtime grouping map over generated IDs or replace legacy entreeGroup checks with generated category/source-role logic.

runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.gap: Runtime and cart imports still point to old Chipotle data
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.evidence: lib/restaurants.ts dynamically loads data/restaurants/chipotle.json and lib/cart/cartItemLookup.ts statically imports it.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.impact: A partial switch would make page and cart resolution disagree.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.resolution: When promotion is approved, switch both lookup paths atomically, following the Chick-fil-A precedent.

runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.gap: Legacy IDs, URLs, and persisted carts
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.evidence: Runtime slugs derive from item.id; generated IDs differ for every mapped product, and cart main-item resolution is strict by ID.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.impact: Existing Chipotle item URLs and persisted carts will stop resolving without redirects/migration. Name fallback does not cover the main cart item.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.resolution: Choose and implement an old-to-generated ID redirect/cart migration policy using this audit's mapping groups.

runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.gap: Homepage Chipotle editorial IDs are old-format
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.evidence: app/page.tsx references high-protein-high-fiber-bowl, high-protein-low-calorie-bowl, guacamole, queso-blanco, chicken, and fajita-veggies.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.impact: Homepage walkthrough/preview content will fail to resolve after promotion.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.resolution: Re-key the editorial selections to generated IDs and verify the intended component contexts.

runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.gap: Generated provenance source shape is not represented by the current runtime source type
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.evidence: MenuItem.source is typed as MenuSourceIdentity with menu.tags and menu.pins, while generated Chipotle records carry provider, restaurantId, menu.itemIds/itemType/itemCategory/role, and nutrition provenance.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.impact: Importing the generated JSON without an explicit compatible type boundary can fail TypeScript structural checks or encourage an unsafe broad cast that hides real schema differences.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.resolution: Define a source-provenance union/shared generated-source type or strip provenance only at a typed runtime adapter boundary; do not mutate the generated records.

runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.gap: Eight generated variant-container ingredients omit base nutrition required by IngredientItem
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.evidence: CMG-5551 and the seven standard protein-family parents carry valid variants/defaultVariantId but no top-level nutrition. IngredientItem.nutrition is required, and buildAllChipotleIngredientMenuItems/buildChipotleIngredientMenuItems call scaleNutritionValues on ingredient.nutrition before resolving a default variant.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.impact: The current Chipotle ingredient adapter can throw or normalize an invalid undefined base when it encounters these records, even though their variants are nutritionally complete.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.resolution: Teach the runtime adapter to resolve default-variant nutrition for variant-container ingredients, and widen the data-facing type accordingly. Do not fabricate or copy base nutrition into generated JSON.

runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.evidence: All 77 generated items use image=none and all 72 generated ingredients omit image; multiple runtime surfaces pass image values directly to next/image.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.impact: A direct swap would produce missing imagery and can pass the literal string none to image rendering paths that do not uniformly guard it.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.resolution: Apply mapped local images before promotion and define fallbacks/assets for the 45 new-only records.

runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.evidence: Old items use Chips & Dips, Single Sides, Protein Meals, Protein Cups, Fountain Drinks, Tractor Beverages, Kids Drinks, and Drinks. Generated items mostly collapse to Sides, Beverages, Preconfigured Meals, and entree-format categories.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.impact: The menu remains data-valid but materially changes browse organization and default order.
runtimeSchemaAndBehaviorGaps.resolution: Choose an overlay taxonomy and place the 45 new-only records within it.

chickFilAPrecedentFindings: Keep registry metadata in data/restaurants/index.json separate from menu generation.
Treat generated source data as canonical and migrate only explicit production enrichment.
Switch the page loader and cart lookup together.
Keep the old file in place temporarily as fallback/reference.
Use sourceOnly filtering for structural records; Chipotle already has three such records and the shared runtime helper supports it.

productDecisions.question: Preserve the old detailed Chipotle browse sections as the primary UI taxonomy, or use the generated coarse categories and retain old labels only as secondary grouping?
productDecisions.recommendation: Preserve the detailed old taxonomy as an overlay for high-confidence mapped records, then explicitly place new-only records.

productDecisions.question: Should generated regular/large sides remain separate source-identity cards, or should the UI regroup them as variants while retaining generated IDs underneath?
productDecisions.recommendation: Keep generated records separate for the first promotion; regroup only through an explicit presentation model later.

productDecisions.question: Should the UI keep the old nine-choice chooser with grouped Kids/Tacos/menu sections, or expose the eight generated build containers directly?
productDecisions.recommendation: Keep the familiar old chooser and adapt it to generated build IDs; it also preserves Chips & Sides, Drinks, and High Protein entry points.

productDecisions.question: May the old shared fruit artwork be used for the source-generic Kid's Fruit record?
productDecisions.recommendation: Yes for the image only; do not preserve the Mandarins or Blueberries names/identities.

productDecisions.question: Should old Chipotle URLs and persisted carts be migrated, redirected, or allowed to expire?
productDecisions.recommendation: Redirect old item routes and migrate persisted cart IDs where mappings are one-to-one; invalidate ambiguous/obsolete records with a clear message.

productDecisions.question: Use restaurant-logo placeholders at launch or curate images before promotion for 45 new-only generated records?
productDecisions.recommendation: Require at least category-safe fallbacks before promotion; prioritize the eight build containers, Pollo Asado, Chili Lime Chips, and six current preset meals.

readiness.assessment: The generated dataset is ready to be the canonical Chipotle data source, but promotion should wait for a generated-ID enrichment layer plus navigation, entreeGroup, cart/URL, homepage-ID, and image compatibility work. No nutrition or current-menu data issue blocks promotion.
